title: dispatching
description: Transformer schema for the dispatching family. Per code/transformers/dispatching.md, the transformer takes a (workitem, receiver-pool, match-rule) tuple and returns a response cell plus a dispatch-witness. Every dispatching-* skill inherits this contract at MCP-registration time via the harness's contract composer (skill.md §158, _compose-skill-contract.mjs §69-79). The composer extracts `input` and `output` as top-level cells on this schema; they become the per-skill input and output validators.

output.description: Response cell from the receiver plus the dispatched-as cell. The shape of the response cell itself is receiver-specific; this schema pins only the dispatched-as and witness cells the dispatch chain itself contributes.

dispatched-as.description: Slug of the dispatch layer that handled the workitem.
